evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: New 青少年/せいしょうねん article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Young people of both sexes. Ordinary approximate 12-25 and ordinance-linked under-18 dictionary ranges are source definitions, not universal current legal cutoffs.

rows.mappingNote: New 整数/せいすう article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Integers include negatives and zero. Distinguish value from decimal notation; no ungrounded integer-versus-general-number exclusion.

rows.mappingNote: New 清掃/せいそう article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive cleaning/cleanup; also recognize garbage collection. Not broom-only or municipal-only; useful reciprocal links from 清 and 掃.

rows.mappingNote: New 生存/せいぞん article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive survival/being alive, distinct from routine daily living or mere nonliving existence. Preserve primary せいぞん rather than replacing it with public alternate せいそん.

rows.mappingNote: New 生長/せいちょう article; keep distinct same-reading 成長.
rows.sourceNote: Plant-growth learning focus, with explicit acknowledgment of public broader/older uses and 成長's plant sense. Do not impose an absolute people-versus-plants spelling partition.

rows.mappingNote: New 政党/せいとう article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Political organization, not a member despite the raw parenthetical gloss. 党 has the same complete title and deduplicates; パーティー also has an ordinary political-party sense and needs a direct precaution.

rows.mappingNote: New 生年月日/せいねんがっぴ article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Full birth year/month/day with established がっぴ pronunciation. 誕生日 can also identify the original birth day, so the annual-occurrence contrast is qualified.

rows.mappingNote: New 性能/せいのう article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Device/tool performance and capability, with public older innate-ability recognition. Distinguish function from how well something works without a historical machine-only absolute.

rows.mappingNote: New 整備/せいび article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive maintenance/servicing and putting in order/developing/equipping, including documents and infrastructure. Does not require damage. Preserve unwritten-card component 整 in metadata.

rows.mappingNote: New 成分/せいぶん article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Constituent/ingredient/composition. Grammar and vector components are separately supported public extensions, not extra pinned sense indices or separate N2 assignments.

rows.mappingNote: New 性別/せいべつ article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Sex/gender classification with no imposed universal biological/social/legal taxonomy or assumptions about form response options.

rows.mappingNote: New 正方形/せいほうけい article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Four equal sides and four right angles; four corners or equal sides alone are insufficient. Direct 四角 and 四角い precautions are not inferred transitively.

rows.mappingNote: New 正門/せいもん article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Main/front gate, not every building's front door. Useful reciprocal 門 example and bounded 門/入口/玄関 label safeguards.

rows.mappingNote: New 成立/せいりつ article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive formation, conclusion/completion/approval and argument validity. Law passage does not independently establish entry into force; account for secondary senses rather than completion alone.

rows.mappingNote: New 西暦/せいれき article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: CE/AD year numbering and Western Gregorian calendar. Not merely a printed calendar or a historical period. Retain 暦 despite its absent kanji card.

source.waller_definition: to be burdened with,to carry on back or shoulder

rows.mappingNote: New 背負う/せおう article; source primary reading retained.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive carrying on the back, burdens and background. Explicitly separate しょう/しょってる-only intransitive conceit from せおう. Search-only 脊負う is not taught as an equal recommended spelling.

rows.mappingNote: New 赤道/せきどう article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Terrestrial and celestial equator. Earth latitude zero is a line, not the tropical zone; separate the cadastral-road あかみち/あかどう identity.

rows.mappingNote: New usual-kana せっかく article explicitly recognizing source spelling 折角.
rows.sourceNote: Effort/trouble, valuable opportunity and kind offer. Positive and thwarted constructions both taught; primary kana metadata has no written kanji. Link 折 and 角 from alias recognition without literal folded-corner etymology or inflating primary reciprocal counts.

rows.mappingNote: New 接近/せっきん article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive physical approach, closeness in age/skill, and friendly relations. Neither contact nor romance is entailed. Reciprocal 接 example explicitly explains small っ.

source.waller_definition: to come in contact with,to connect,to attend,to receive

rows.mappingNote: New 接する/せっする article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Special-class する, not free noun 接 plus regular する. Includes adjacency/contact, dealing with people, news, encounters, tangency, and transitive bringing together. Supplemental 応接 family inspected; absent exploratory 接す explicitly recorded rather than fabricated.

The initial collector failed explicitly rather than writing an incomplete family set; exclude this form from the successful capture without inventing an identity or claiming lexical absence.

sourceMappingDecisions: Twenty new articles; every original source field remains unchanged.
折角/せっかく maps to primary usual-kana せっかく, with explicit kanji alias and component navigation.
Plant-focused 生長 and machine-focused 性能 are editorial learning focuses, not absolute semantic or historical prohibitions.
政党 is the organization, not a member; source gloss wording is preserved as source data.
背負う/せおう excludes the しょう-only しょってる conceit sense from the primary reading.
crossReferencePlan: Six primary-spelling reciprocal N2 pairs: 清/清掃, 掃/清掃, 党/政党, 門/正門, 接/接近 and 接/接する.
Additional 角/折角 alias navigation links the kana-primary せっかく article without inflating primary-spelling pairs.
Narrow existing comparisons become links; 成長 receives a brief qualified plant-growth comparison.
inspectionStageAdvance.limits: Author read accounting, not independent review or runtime quiz proof. Prepared but unselected existing bodies remain capture-only; principal families are included, not counted twice. No repository content changed at this stage.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses for independent assessment, not reviewer findings or reproduced runtime quiz draws. Guards are direct, symmetric, pairwise/nontransitive; neither old guards nor a shared topic establishes a new pair.
青少年 guards the actual youth/boy/girl/child labels; overlapping ranges do not make age boundaries universal. 整数 has no number/digit hypernym guards.
清掃 guards cleaning, broad washing/tidying, and collection labels in its garbage-collection range. This does not make every collection a cleanup or every tidying activity washing.

生存 guards living/alive/existence/life labels including broader animate existence and daily living as conservative English precautions, while the prose separates daily routine, life as a noun, and nonliving existence. Lifespan, lived experience and organisms alone do not establish safeguards.
生長 considers each actual growth/development/growing label directly, including 成長's plant sense. Same pronunciation alone is not the reason; no human/plant exclusive partition is asserted.
政党 and 党 have identical complete titles and already deduplicate. パーティー independently has an ordinary political-party sense; social gathering is not its whole family.
生年月日 guards the actual birthday and calendar-date labels. Full birth date and annual birthday remain distinguished; the original-birth-day 誕生日 sense is not denied.
性能 guards actual ability/function/performance labels as broad English precautions, not a claim that every achievement or test grade is a machine capability. 性別 guards 性's actual sex/gender range.

整備 guards actual maintenance/servicing, preparation, arranging and equipping/development labels one by one, including 修理's servicing sense and 維持's maintenance sense. These do not form a preparation-word clique; routine servicing need not repair damage.
成分 guards actual constituent/ingredient/material/element/part/composition labels. Inputs and resulting constituents are compared, not equated in every context.
正方形 safeguards both 四角 and 四角い directly; their existing mutual guard is not transitive. General 形 is not excluded just because a square is a shape.
正門 safeguards the actual broad gate/entrance labels 門/入口/玄関; it does not turn every indoor entrance into a gate.

成立 considers formation/completion/approval/validity/conclusion labels, not only its leading sense. No planning synonym is inferred just from an English arrangement gloss, and enactment is not assumed to establish entry into force.
西暦 guards calendar and broad era/age labels as English precautions; year notation differs from a calendar object and a historical period.

背負う guards actual carrying/holding labels with relevant burden senses, preserving back/shoulder/arm differences. Responsibility as a noun is not alone a verb-level guard. No conceit guard is inferred for primary せおう.
せっかく guards actual valuable/precious, kindness and effort/trouble labels as contextual English precautions. The construction is not asserted to be a free synonym of each comparison noun/adjective.
接近 guards directly relevant closeness/approach labels, including physical closeness and intimacy. Touch-only labels are not added merely because approaching may lead to contact.

接する considers all six ordinary/technical senses: actual touching/adjacency/closeness, treating/receiving people, receiving news, meeting/encountering and connecting/bringing together. Broad receiving precautions do not assert unrestricted honorific substitution or permission to receive every object with 接する.
赤道 has no new guards; equator is not automatically a synonym of the tropical zone, a road, or latitude generally. Absence of guards is not exhaustive semantic certification.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty new articles map twenty community-list rows, not an official syllabus. All raw CSV fields are preserved.

The twenty principal families/38 senses are included, not added again, in 346 families/891 senses. Source selection is not recovered compiler intent or an independent N2 assignment for each taught sense.
背負う selects せおう-compatible senses 1-3; additional sense 4 is explicitly restricted to しょう/しょってる. Search-only 脊負う is not recommended as an equal normal spelling.
Six primary reciprocal pairs: 清/清掃, 掃/清掃, 党/政党, 門/正門, 接/接近 and 接/接する. 角/折角 alias navigation does not inflate this count. No character metadata/stroke changes.
Seven old word edits add links only; 成長 additionally gains the sourced qualified 生長 comparison. Baseline identities, readings, titles, exclusions and easier levels remain preserved.
Absent exploratory 接す is explicitly recorded and omitted from the pinned collector. Actual public classical evidence does not invent a pinned family.

Only 131 selected old full bodies were inspected; other captured bodies remain capture-only. The shared blind derivative omits only quizGuardRationale. CLEAN and validators are not exhaustive linguistic or runtime quiz certification.

Both examined era exclusions but proposed opposing remedies; source-based adjudication favors removing the period guards, not expanding them. Findings, Optional, Limits and per-file notes were compared. GPT inspected substantially more comparison bodies/families and made fresh retrievals; Claude used the captures and disclosed narrower source depth. Useful complementary evidence, not a controlled benchmark, model ranking or proof of bias elimination.
